item.title: The Alpha Flow: A. Evapotranspiration Cools the Earth - FarOut Show
item.description: The water cycle plays a crucial role in regulating temperature on Earth. As rain falls, it eventually evaporates through transpiration from plants, releasing heat into the atmosphere. This process, known as evapotranspiration, contributes to cooling the environment, emphasising the importance of green spaces and water absorption in urban planning to mitigate heat waves and urban heating.

item.title: The Alpha Flow: B. Small Water Cycle Creates Rain - FarOut Show
